ops.reason: elbow: a second ring between elbow and forearm so the elbow bends, not kinks
stifle: a second ring between stifle and gaskin for the hind-leg bend
neck: a ring between C1 and N0 so the head-down charge bends the short neck
eye socket: a loop inside the eye face, under the brow
tail tuft: a ring in the long T0-T1 span (no needle quads)
tail stalk: a ring in the long T2-T3 span (no needle quads)
